$Comment: What players see the moment a boss fight starts: the fight is engaged, the boss is
vulnerable and the first member is on it.
This is the library's own neutral default. A mod that ships a file with this same name in its
own pack replaces it, and a server owner can do the same from the owner layer; the binding row
under Server/ZiggfreedCommon/Encounters can also point a fight at a moment of another name
The moment fires once PER MEMBER of the fight, and carries 'encounter' (the script id),
'title' (the fight's name, already in the reader's language), 'members' (how many are in it),
'seconds' (how long the run has been going), 'participants' (the members, for the banner's
ToParticipants) and 'source' (the script id again, for the banner's MinSecondsBetween).
'player' is always the name of the member it is about.
A boss engaging is the one beat here that speaks to players who did not ask: the banner is
kept to the world the fight is in (SameWorldOnly), shown once a minute per fight however many
members fire it (MinSecondsBetween), and always shown to the members themselves
(ToParticipants). Add RadiusBlocks to keep it to the arena, or drop the Broadcast group to
tell nobody but the members through a Toast of your own. The fight's own music is the
script's business, which is why there is no Sound here.
